gen-fs-oswald-gf-cambay: Confident, tightly knit Oswald rows stand tall over Cambay, whose round letters gap open like a cracked bangle. Oswald hits hard; Cambay stays easygoing.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-cantarell: Cantarell reads friendly and unfussy, its c tips pulled apart and its arches matching the stems. And Oswald, drawn low and tightly knit above, makes that poured, single-width body feel even softer.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-catamaran: Neutral and curvy, Catamaran feels unclamped under Oswald's strong lines. Oswald's tightly knit rows give the pair its backbone, while the loose body curves keep it friendly.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Tight, strong, and a bit stern up top. Oswald holds the rows close, and Chiron Hei HK follows with a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart, so the page has both muscle and room.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-commissioner: Commissioner reads smooth, with no clogged curves and every stroke drawn at one thickness. And Oswald, low and tightly knit above it, gives way to joins that never thin out where strokes meet.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-didact-gothic: Modern and confident, Oswald packs its rows tight while Didact Gothic never snags on a closed-up bowl. And its diagonals carry as much weight as its verticals, so a larger body size would sit well under the heading.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads approachable, with wide channels leading into each counter and a tube-like thickness through every bend. Oswald's tight rows sit above it, low and strong.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-doto: Oswald's tightly knit rows look confident and strong, a dense block of display letters sitting over Doto's wide margins around each glyph. Shrink the heading and that density fades; enlarge the body and its mouths gape.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-el-messiri: Oswald sets confident, tightly knit rows, low and strong, while El Messiri adds a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot in its c. Shrink the heading and that strength thins out.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-electrolize: Electrolize reads modern, its open-jawed c like a pair of pliers gripping each line. Electrolize against Oswald's tightly knit, confident rows makes the pair feel strong and contemporary at once.
